keg.description: Stores suitable ales for drinking aboard your boat.

innoculation-station.description: Protects the boat while crossing the fetid waters of the Shrouded Ocean.
innoculation-station.name: Inoculation station

salvaging-station.description: Sort shipwreck salvage aboard a skiff or sloop instead of returning to a port. Requires the salvaging station schematic.

chum-station.description: Cuts fish into regular offcuts and spreads them as bait while trawling.
chum-station.stats:
Fish cut per tick: 2
Extra catch chance with bait: 20%

bosun-s-workbench.description: Lets an assigned crewmate repair your boat using repair kits from the cargo hold.

advanced-chum-station.description: Cuts fish into offcuts and spreads regular or fine offcuts as trawling bait.
advanced-chum-station.stats:
Fish cut per tick: 3
Extra catch chance with bait: 20%

chum-spreader.description: Processes fish into offcuts faster than the advanced chum station and spreads trawling bait.
chum-spreader.stats:
Fish cut per tick: 4
Extra catch chance with bait: 20%

wind-catcher.description: Stores wind motes that can be released for a burst of boat speed.

crystal-extractor.description: Produces wind motes for a wind catcher or gale catcher while sailing.

gale-catcher.description: An improved wind catcher that stores extra motes for bursts of speed.

anchor-facility.description: Holds your boat in place at sea. The anchored boat can still turn.

ballistic-attractor.description: Recovers some cannonballs fired by cannons aboard your boat. Requires its schematic.

teleport-focus-facility.description: Enables Summon Boat to bring your docked boat to your current dock or mooring. Summoning can lose some cargo.
teleport-focus-facility.name: Teleportation focus (facility)

fathom-stone.description: Locates nearby fishing shoals and reports their direction.

greater-teleport-focus.description: Enables Teleport to Boat as well as Summon Boat. The regular focus is not a required earlier build.
greater-teleport-focus.name: Greater teleportation focus (facility)

fathom-pearl.description: Locates nearby fishing shoals and also marks their direction on the minimap.

rope-trawling-net.description: Catches fish from suitable shoals while deep sea trawling.
rope-trawling-net.stats:
Depths: Shallow
Maximum fish per action: 2

linen-trawling-net.description: Catches fish from suitable shoals while deep sea trawling.
linen-trawling-net.stats:
Depths: Shallow and moderate
Maximum fish per action: 3

hemp-trawling-net.description: Catches fish from suitable shoals while deep sea trawling.
hemp-trawling-net.stats:
Depths: All
Maximum fish per action: 4

cotton-trawling-net.description: Catches fish from suitable shoals while deep sea trawling.
cotton-trawling-net.stats:
Depths: All
Maximum fish per action: 5
